title: SaaS master services agreement review against the client's playbook

traps.title: Missing that §9.1 swallows §10.1
traps.wrong_move: Reading §10.1 'uncapped' and ticking A1 as satisfied
traps.why_wrong: 'Notwithstanding anything to the contrary' in §9.1 + §9.3 carve-outs omit §10.1 → the IP indemnity is capped at $222k
traps.harm: Client believes it has uncapped IP protection; a real infringement claim could cost millions

traps.title: Accepting 'DPA to be attached'
traps.why_wrong: No Art. 28 contract at signing; EU data flows immediately

traps.title: Missing the price-change right in the order form
Flagging the gross-negligence carve-out
traps.why_wrong: Playbook B1 says accept it; pushback tests whether the model read the playbook

traps.title: Auto-renewal / affiliates
traps.why_wrong: A4 and A5 hard rules; affiliates confirmed by client

oracle.item: issues.json contains A1 (§9.1 vs §10.1 interaction), A2, A3 (order form), A4, A5
issues.json does NOT flag §9.3 carve-out, Delaware law, jury waiver, 15-day suspension or 30-day export as issues

rubric: COO one-pager names the capped-indemnity problem in plain English
notes: MSA is ~5 rendered pages rather than the 28 of the design doc; sufficient for the cross-clause trap. Modeled on EDGAR-style SaaS MSAs; names invented.
